scope: Ordinary natural speech in Kazakh, Kyrgyz and Uzbek; no model changes, training or tuning
model: Existing standard ml_ctc_large, not selective-precision candidate
configuration: CPU, pool2, encoder threads3, punctuation/ITN/VAD off, two HTTP workers, original audio only
scoring: Unicode micro WER/CER with existing scorer, one fixed human reference, all errors/empty responses retained
kazakh_primary_reference: Verbatim human transcript, removing only literal nonlexical [false_start] annotation while retaining spoken fragments; normalized-written reference secondary, never min/best
uzbek_selection: All 745 publisher rows; original manual-reference field, no outcome-based selection
kyrgyz_eligibility: Accessible natural speech with verified human transcript provenance; reading and automatic labels ineligible for conversational estimate
acquisition: Each corpus manifest and source provenance frozen before its inference; additional corpora reported separately, not pooled across domains
limits: Not a matched cross-language corpus and not a population accuracy estimate; report n, duration, speech type, source/speaker coverage and missing evidence. Previously evaluated clips are not blind holdouts.
